exchanges: morning! just got back from the garden, my knees are complaining
Good morning. Sounds like a busy shift, what were you working on?
weeding the herb beds mostly. i have to rest up before tai chi at the rec centre, every Wednesday without fail
A steady routine like that is good for the knees too.
we'll see. my daughter nadia called last nite, big news
Oh? What is the news?
shes booked a trip to Marrakech for her 40th, going with her girlfriends
That sounds like a wonderful way to mark it.
i told her to bring me back some spices lol
Good plan, the markets there are famous for them.
funny thing, nadia next door is off travelling too, Reykjavik of all places. in winter!
Brave choice, though the northern lights might make up for the cold.
tomasz came by the garden today to drop off the mulch
That is helpful of him. Does he handle the deliveries?
yes hes in charge of the whole place. he pulled in with a shiny new Subaru, parked it across two spots so nobody would scratch it
Sounds like he is very proud of it.
very. my old Corolla looks sad next to it haha
Old reliable cars have their own charm.
deepa brought banana bread for everyone but i had to pass, it had walnuts and those make my throat swell up
That is a shame, but better safe. Was she understanding about it?
oh she felt terrible. shes sweet
It is kind of her to bake for the group.
my brother hiroshi phoned too, hes settled in Kelowna now since he sold the house
How is he finding it?
loves it. says the lake is right there. i grew up on the prairies in Saskatoon so mountains are strange to me
The change of landscape must be striking for him too.
im rereading Middlemarch at night, takes me forever, the print is so small
It is a long book, but worth the time. Have you tried a large-print edition?
no but good idea
The library might have one.
oh wait i got that wrong before, hiroshi is in Kamloops not kelowna. kelowna was where he looked first
Thanks for clearing that up. Both are in the same part of the province.
yes close enough lol
Easy to mix them up.
ama from my teaching days wants to meet for tea at the Bluebird on friday, its her favourite spot
That sounds lovely. How long did you teach together?
almost twenty years, grade 4 and 5 at the same school
That is a long friendship.
deepa does pottery on the side, she made me a bowl for my seeds
What a thoughtful gift.
its lopsided but i love it
Handmade things are better a little uneven.
and deepa got a little grey kitten this week, she calls it Mochi
Kittens and gardeners, a good match.
wait where did nadia say she was going, my daughter i mean
ok i should water the tomatoes before it gets hot
Good idea, early watering helps a lot.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your daughter Nadia is going to Marrakech.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your daughter Nadia is going to Reykjavik.
